items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_X_mul'
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (MvPolynomial.X s * p).coeff m = if s ∈ m.support then p.coeff (m - fun₀ | s => 1) else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_X'
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (p * MvPolynomial.X s).coeff m = if s ∈ m.support then p.coeff (m - fun₀ | s => 1) else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial_mul'
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (m s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) r * p).coeff m = if s ≤ m then r * p.coeff (m - s) else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_monomial'
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (m s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (p * (MvPolynomial.monomial s) r).coeff m = if s ≤ m then p.coeff (m - s) * r else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_sub
items.type: {R : Type u} (σ : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) : (p - q).coeff m = p.coeff m - q.coeff m
